description: This Java class NoteService provides the business logic for managing notes, including creating, updating, retrieving, deleting, and listing notes with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

classes.name: NoteService
classes.description: Service layer for notes business logic, handling create, read, update, delete, and list operations for notes.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new note from a NoteRequest DTO, initializes timestamps, and saves it via the repository.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note by ID using data from a NoteRequest DTO, throws NotFoundException if the note doesn't exist.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID, throws NotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID; throws NotFoundException if the note does not exist.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of notes with optional search filtering, sorting by specified fields (title or updatedAt), order (asc or desc), and pagination (page and size).
